items.markdown:
A Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care (CHC50125) `qualifies you to design learning programs and take leadership roles in regulated Australian childcare centers and preschools` . The course costs roughly AUD 4,000 to AUD 18,615 and takes 1 to 2 years to complete, requiring 280 hours of practical placement.[](https://www.tafensw.edu.au/course-areas/education-and-training/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care--CHC50125-01) [[1]](https://www.tafensw.edu.au/course-areas/education-and-training/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care--CHC50125-01)[[2]](https://www.swinburne.edu.au/course/tafe/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)[[3]](https://www.leadcollege.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)[[4]](https://www.idp.com/india/study-in-australia/diploma-in-early-childhood-education-in-australia/)

Key Details & Requirements

- **Entry Requirements:** You typically need to hold a Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care (CHC30121 or CHC30113) or have verifiable, full-time industry experience.
- **Practical Component:** Mandatory 280-hour workplace placement.
- **Career Outcomes:** Positions include Lead Educator, Centre Manager, or Early Childhood Coordinator.[](https://cit.edu.au/courses/education-community/childrens-education-care/DP-HS65) [[1]](https://cit.edu.au/courses/education-community/childrens-education-care/DP-HS65)[[2]](https://www.tafensw.edu.au/course-areas/education-and-training/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care--CHC50125-01)[[3]](https://www.swinburne.edu.au/course/tafe/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)[[4]](https://www.idp.com/india/study-in-australia/diploma-in-early-childhood-education-in-australia/)[[5]](https://www.edunex.edu.au/rt-program/certificate-iii-in-early-childhood-education-and-care-2/)

Popular Providers Leading vocational and tertiary institutions offer this nationally recognized qualification. You can explore program structures, tuition, and enrollment dates directly via the following official pages:[](https://www.tafensw.edu.au/course-areas/education-and-training/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care--CHC50125-01) [[1]](https://www.tafensw.edu.au/course-areas/education-and-training/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care--CHC50125-01)

- **[Victoria University](https://www.vu.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-chc50125)** [[1]](https://deltaimmigration.com.au/Study-in-Toowoomba-Queensland-at-TAFE-Queensland/109290B-3-Diploma-of-Early-Childhood-Education-and-Care.htm)

Career & Pathway Opportunities Diploma-qualified educators are in high demand across Australia, with up to 10,000 child care center manager roles expected to open in the coming years. Furthermore, for those interested in advancing to a Bachelor of Education, the diploma often provides up to 1 year of equivalent credit points toward a university degree.[](https://tafeqld.edu.au/course/17/17801/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care) [[1]](https://tafeqld.edu.au/course/17/17801/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care)[[2]](https://www.westernsydney.edu.au/tertiary-education-pathways-and-partnerships/vet-categories-and-courses/childrens-services/diploma-of-early-childhood)[[3]](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/bachelor/early-childhood-education/)[[4]](https://pche.lk/australian-diploma-courses/)
